title: Real Fights
notes: BALANCE FIX: mashing SPACE or AUTO ATTACK made you practically immortal (every enemy hit was auto-parried). Now mashing BLOCKS (half damage + small counter), and only your own calm, timed press is a PERFECT PARRY (no damage, stun, big counter).
Enemies hit softer overall to make up for it, so fights are a real challenge again without instant deaths.
Lifesteal from all sources together is capped at 20%.
NEW: separate Skills tab in the menu bar with your skills, Ki costs and Skill Mastery.
NEW: Screen shake can be turned off in the menu (Esc).
